species.summary: Remelana jangala, the chocolate royal, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly found in Asia.
Lethe europa, the bamboo treebrown, is a species of Satyrinae butterfly found in Asia.
Lyncina lynx, common name : the lynx cowry or eyed cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Melanitis phedima, the dark evening brown, is a species of butterfly found flying at dusk. The flight of this species is erratic. They are found in South Asia.
Parantica aspasia, the yellow glassy tiger, is a butterfly found in Asia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.

Cyclosa bifida adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1859 oleh Doleschall.

Ptocasius weyersi adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Ptocasius dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1885 oleh Simon.
Euploea phaenareta, the giant crow is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by Johann Gottlieb Schaller in 1785. It is found in the Indomalayan realm and the Australasian realm.

species.name: Tawon Bendera
species.summary: Evania appendigaster is a species of wasp in the family Evaniidae, the ensign wasps. Its native range is not known, but it likely originated in Asia. Today it occurs throughout the tropics and subtropics and in many temperate regions. It is a parasitoid wasp known for specializing on cockroaches.
Hippotion celerio, the vine hawk-moth or silver-striped hawk-moth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It was described by Carl Linnaeus in his 1758 10th edition of Systema Naturae.

species.name: Ampal
species.summary: Lepidiota stigma adalah serangga hama polifag (pemakan rupa-rupa) yang menyerang perakaran berbagai jenis tumbuhan. Fase hidup yang paling mengganggu pertanian adalah fase larva yang dikenal dengan nama umum hama uret atau gayas. Serangga tahap dewasa dikenal sebagai ampal.

Phyllidiopsis krempfi is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusk in the family Phyllidiidae. This species was named to honour Armand Krempf, a French marine biologist and director of the Nha Trang Institute of Oceanography (Vietnam) from 1921.

The Metallic jumper, (Siler semiglaucus), also known as colorful jumping spider, or Jade jumping spider (玉翠蛛 : Chinese), is a species of spider of the genus Siler. It is found throughout India to Philippines.

Tirumala hamata, the blue tiger, dark blue tiger or blue wanderer, is a butterfly of the Nymphalidae family. It is found in South-East Asia and Australia. In Australia, the butterflies perform mass migrations to the south in some years.

Archaster typicus is a species of starfish in the family Archasteridae. It is commonly known as the sand star or the sand sifting star but these names are also applied to starfish in the genus Astropecten. It is found in shallow waters in the Indo-Pacific region.
Coenobita violascens is a species of land hermit crab native to the Indonesia, Nicobar Islands, Thailand, Cambodia, Philippines, and Tanzania.

Cytaea dispalans adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Cytaea dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1892 oleh Thorell.
Euploea climena is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Caspar Stoll in 1782. It is found in the Indomalayan realm and the Australasian realm.
Stenocatantops splendens is a species of short-horned grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in Indomalaya and eastern Asia.

Xystrocera festiva adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong familia Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Xystrocera, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Hidari irava, the coconut skipper, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found in southern Myanmar, Thailand, western Malaysia, as well as on Sumatra, Java, Borneo and the Sula Islands.
Loxura atymnus, the yamfly, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly found in Asia.
Odontoptilum angulata, the chestnut angle or banded angle, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae and is found in Asia.
Tetragnatha hasselti is a species of long-jawed orb weaver spider in the family Tetragnathidae. It has a wide distribution across Asia, from India to China and Indonesia (Sulawesi).
Discophora sondaica, the common duffer, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Southeast Asia.
Eupanacra elegantulus is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from south-east Asia, including Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia the Philippines.

Euploea eleusina, or Vollenhov's crow, is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Pieter Cramer in 1777. It is found in the Indomalayan realm crossing the Wallace line to Sulawesi in the Australasian realm.

Leptoglossus gonagra, known generally as the passionvine bug or citron bug, is a species of leaf-footed bug in the family Coreidae. It is found in Africa, Australia, the Caribbean, Central America, North America, Oceania, South America, and Southern Asia.

Saron marmoratus, the marbled shrimp, is a species of "cleaner shrimp" from the family Thoridae, although its taxonomic position is subject to some controversy as many authorities have considered it to be a member of the family Hippolytidae sensu lato.

Tirumala limniace, the blue tiger, is a butterfly found in India that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterfly family. This butterfly shows gregarious migratory behaviour in southern India.
Cepora judith is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It has no common name, although a subspecies is referred to as the orange gull. It is found in south-eastern Asia (see subspecies section).
Mauritia arabica, common name the Arabian cowry, is a species of cowry, a sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

Nilus albocinctus, synonym Thalassius albocinctus, commonly called the fishing spider, is a species of spider found in tropical Asia from India to the Philippines. It is named after its habit of catching small fish.

Tylorida striata is a species of spider in the family Tetragnathidae. It was first described by Tamerlan Thorell in 1877. The species has a wide distribution across tropical Asia and northern Australia.

Cyrtophora cicatrosa adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1869 oleh Stoliczka.

Cyrtophora unicolor adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1857 oleh Doleschall.
Heterometrus longimanus, the Black Emperor Scorpion or Asian forest scorpion, is a species of scorpions belonging to the family Scorpionidae.

Hippasa holmerae is a species of wolf spider in the family Lycosidae. It was first described by Tamerlan Thorell in 1895 based on specimens collected from Burma. The species is commonly known as the lawn wolf spider and has a wide distribution across Asia.

species.name: Walang Sangit
species.summary: Leptocorisa oratoria, the rice ear bug, is an insect from the family Alydidae, the broad-headed bugs. This species is commonly confused with Leptocorisa acuta, a similar and closely related species, called the rice earhead bug.

Papilio ulysses, the Ulysses butterfly (also commonly known as the Blue emperor), is a large swallowtail butterfly of Australia, Indonesia, Papua New Guinea and the Solomon Islands. Its size varies depending on subspecies, but the wingspan is about 10.5 cm (4.1 in) in Queensland.
Neptis columella, the short banded sailer, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South and Southeast Asia.
Pseudoxya diminuta is an Asian species of grasshopper.
Psilogramma discistriga is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Bangladesh.
Rhinopalpa polynice, the wizard, is a nymphalid butterfly found in India and South Asia, and is the only species in the genus Rhinopalpa.

Sarasinula plebeia, commonly called the bean slug or the Caribbean leatherleaf slug, is a species of air-breathing land slug, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Veronicellidae, the leatherleaf slugs.

species.name: Susuh Kura
species.summary: Susuh kura (Sulcospira testudinaria) adalah sejenis siput air tawar yang termasuk ke dalam suku Pachychilidae. Siput kecil ini didapati hidup terbatas (endemik) di perairan tawar Indonesia bagian barat.

Symbrenthia lilaea, the common jester, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South Asia and Southeast Asia. It forms a superspecies with Symbrenthia hippoclus and there are numerous regional forms and the taxonomy of the group is not well resolved.

Amplypterus panopus, the mango hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found in Sri Lanka, southern and northern India (including the Andaman Islands and Nicobar Islands), Nepal, Burma, southern China, Thailand, Vietnam, Laos, Indonesia (to Sulawesi) and the Philippines.
Pycnophallium roxus, the straight Pierrot, is a small butterfly found in India that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Cigaritis lohita, the long-banded silverline, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly.

Danaus melanippus, the black veined tiger, white tiger, common tiger, or eastern common tiger, is a butterfly species found in tropical Asia which belongs to the "crows and tigers", that is, the danaine group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Monetaria caputserpentis, common name the serpent's-head cowry or snakehead cowry, is a species of cowry, a sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

Psilogramma menephron, the privet hawk moth or large brown hawkmoth, is a member of the family Sphingidae. It was described by Pieter Cramer in 1780. It is usually found in Sri Lanka, India (including the Andaman Islands), Nepal, central and southern China, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia and the Philippines.
Scolopendra subspinipes (Vietnamese Centipede) is a species of centipede. The native range is uncertain. The certain natural range is Meganesia and Indomalaya.

species.name: Tonggeret Hijau
species.summary: Dundubia vaginata is the type species in its genus, sometimes called the jade-green cicada (Hemiptera: Cicadidae) in the tribe Dundubiini.

Idea durvillei is a large butterfly that belongs to the danaid group of the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Jean Baptiste Boisduval in 1832. It is found in the Australasian realm. The name honours Jules Dumont d'Urville.
The Bicolored Trailing Ant, (Monomorium floricola), is a species of ant of the subfamily Myrmicinae. It is a widespread, invasive ant which is found all over the world.

Pareronia valeria, the common wanderer or Malayan wanderer, is a medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, and is found in India and Southeast Asia. The butterfly found in India is sometimes considered as a separate species, Pareronia hippia.

Euploea eunice, commonly called blue-banded king crow, is a butterfly found in the Indomalayan realm that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the Danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.

Macracantha arcuata adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1793 oleh Fabricius.
Mycalesis mineus, atau kupu-kupu Dark Brand Bush Brown, adalah kupu-kupu yang termasuk dalam famili Nymphalidae dan subfamili Satyrinae.
Odontomachus simillimus, is a species of ant of the subfamily Ponerinae, which can be found from many Asian, and African countries.

Oxyopes macilentus adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Oxyopidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Oxyopes dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1878 oleh L Koch.
Papilio fuscus, the Canopus swallowtail, is a butterfly of the family Papilionidae, that is found on Timor, northern Australia, and New Guinea.
Athyma nefte, the colour sergeant, is a species of brush-footed butterfly found in tropical South and Southeast Asia.
Polyrhachis bicolor is a member of the camponotin ants in the genus Polyrhachis ranging from Australia to the tip of China.
Theretra nessus, the yam hawk moth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It was described by Dru Drury in 1773.
Asota plana is a moth in the family Erebidae. It is found from the Oriental tropics east to New Guinea.
Celastrina lavendularis, the plain hedge blue, is a small butterfly found in Sri Lanka and South India that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Chalcosoma caucasus (Caucasus beetle) (Thai : ด้วงกวางเขาสามจันทร์) is a species of beetle in the Scarabaeidae family. This species is a senior synonym of Chalcosoma chiron and Chalcosoma janssensi.
Notocrypta paralysos, the banded demon or common banded demon, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.

Pelargoderus bipunctatus adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong familia Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Pelargoderus, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.

Pycanum rubens is a species of giant stink bug in the family Tessaratomidae. The species is widespread, and has been recorded in Borneo, Burma, China (Yunnan), India (Hindustan), Indonesia, Java, the Malay Peninsula, Moluccas, Philippines, Sumatra, and Vietnam.

The emerald cockroach wasp or jewel wasp (Ampulex compressa) is a solitary wasp of the family Ampulicidae. It is known for its unusual reproductive behavior, which involves stinging a cockroach and using it as a host for its larvae. It thus belongs to the entomophagous parasites.
Delias pasithoe, the redbase Jezebel is a medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites. The species is found in parts of South Asia and Southeast Asia.
Euploea radamanthus, the magpie crow, is a butterfly found in India and Southeast Asia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.

species.name: Jangkrik upa
species.summary: Gryllodes sigillatus, known commonly as the Tropical house cricket, Indian house cricket, or the banded cricket, is a small cricket probably native to Southwestern Asia, but has spread throughout tropical regions worldwide.
Heliophorus epicles, commonly known as the purple sapphire, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly found in Asia. The species was first described by Jean Baptiste Godart in 1823.

Leucauge decorata the decorative silver orb spider is one of the long-jawed orb weaver spiders. A medium to large sized orb weaving spider, with a body length up to 12 mm long (female). Male to 6 mm. This species has a "point" to the end of the abdomen. Found in Africa, India, south east Asia, also to Australia.
Macrotermes gilvus is a species of termite in the family Termitidae, found in Cambodia, East Timor, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.
Neostylopyga rhombifolia, the harlequin roach, is a species of cockroach in the family Blattidae. It is found in North America, Oceania, and Southern Asia.
Papilio karna is a species of swallowtail butterfly from the genus Papilio that is found in Java, Sumatra, Borneo and the Philippines.
Athyma perius, the common sergeant, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South Asia and Southeast Asia.

Thelacantha is a spider genus of the Araneidae family with only one described species, Thelacantha brevispina. The species is closely related to Gasteracantha, and was synonymized with it in 1859, but revalidated in 1974.
Appias albina, the common albatross, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found in India, Southeast Asia and Australia.
Daphnis nerii, the oleander hawk-moth or army green moth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It was described by Carl Linnaeus in his 1758 10th edition of Systema Naturae.
Leucauge tessellata is a species of spider in the family Tetragnathidae. It has a wide distribution across Asia, ranging from India to China and Southeast Asia.

Maruca vitrata is a pantropical insect pest of leguminous crops like pigeon pea, cowpea, mung bean and soybean. Its common names include the maruca pod borer, bean pod borer, soybean pod borer, mung moth, and the legume pod borer.

Nihonhimea mundula is a species of cobweb spider in the family Theridiidae. It was originally described by Ludwig Carl Christian Koch in 1872 as Theridion mundulum. The species is commonly known as the comb-footed platform spider or rolled-leaf comb-footed spider.
Papilio nephelus is a species of swallowtail butterfly belonging to the family Papilionidae. Subspecies include P. n. chaon, the yellow Helen, and P. n. sunatus, the black and white Helen.
Polyura hebe, the plain nawab, is a butterfly belonging to the brush-footed butterflies family (Nymphalidae).
Udara akasa, the white hedge blue, is a small butterfly found in India that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Amphidromus palaceus is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Camaenidae.

Cyclosa insulana is a species of orb-weaver spider in the family Araneidae. Its distribution ranges from the Mediterranean region eastward to Japan, India to Papua New Guinea, Australia, and parts of Africa including St. Helena, South Africa, and Eswatini.

Daphnis hypothous, the jade hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae described by Pieter Cramer in 1780. It is known from Sri Lanka, southern and northern India, Nepal, Myanmar, southern China, Taiwan, Thailand, Malaysia, and Indonesia. It is a rare vagrant to the Western Palaearctic ecozone.

Epeus flavobilineatus adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Epeus dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1859 oleh Doleschall.
Lexias dirtea, the archduke, is a species of butterfly of the family Nymphalidae.

Lyssa zampa, which is also known as the tropical swallowtail moth or the Laos brown butterfly, is a species of moth of the family Uraniidae. It can be found from Himalaya to Borneo and the Malay Peninsula.
Rapala iarbus, the common red flash, is a species of lycaenid butterfly found in South and Southeast Asia.

Scirpophaga excerptalis, the white top borer or sugarcane top borer, is a moth in the family Crambidae. It was described by Francis Walker in 1863. It is found in southern Asia from the Indian Subcontinent in the west to southern China in the east, south to New Guinea, possibly Australia and the Solomon Islands.

Ambulyx moorei (cinnamon gliding hawkmoth) is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found in Sri Lanka, southern and eastern India, the Nicobar Islands and Andaman Islands, Thailand, Vietnam, southern China, the Philippines (Palawan, Balabac), Malaysia (Peninsular, Sarawak), Singapore and Indonesia (Sumatra, Java, Kal…

Batocera rubus adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong famili Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Batocera, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Cassida circumdata is a species of tortoise beetle in the family Chrysomelidae. It is found in Indomalaya and the South Pacific islands.
Catochrysops panormus, the silver forget-me-not, is a small butterfly found from India to the Philippines and south to Australia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Oxya japonica, also known as the Japanese grasshopper or rice grasshopper, is a species of short-horned grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in Indomalaya and eastern Asia.

Fire ant is the common name for several species of ants in the genus Solenopsis. They are, however, only a minority in the genus, which includes over 200 species of Solenopsis worldwide. Solenopsis are stinging ants and most of their common names reflect this, for example, ginger ants and tropical fire ants.

Taractrocera archias is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found in mainland south-eastern Asia (Burma, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia), Java and Lesser Sunda Islands (east to Timor and Kisar).

species.name: Kangkok Melayu
species.summary: The Hodgson's hawk-cuckoo (Hierococcyx nisicolor), also known as the whistling hawk-cuckoo is a species of cuckoo found in north-eastern India, Myanmar, southern China and southeast Asia.
Euthalia adonia is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae (Limenitidinae). It is found in the Indomalayan realm.

Harmochirus brachiatus adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Harmochirus dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1877 oleh Thorell.
Tirumala septentrionis atau harimau biru tua, adalah kupu-kupu danaid yang ditemukan di anak benua India dan Asia Tenggara.
Ancistroides nigrita, the chocolate demon, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Jamides bochus, the dark cerulean, is a small butterfly found in India that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Phyllidiella rudmani is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusk in the family Phyllidiidae.
Polyrhachis dives is a wide-ranging species of ant from southern Asia and the Northern Territory of Australia.

Rhene flavigera, commonly known as the beige beetle jumper or Zorro flat-head jumper, is a species of jumping spider in the genus Rhene. It is widely distributed across Asia, from Pakistan to Indonesia and Taiwan.

Bavia sexpunctata adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Bavia dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1859 oleh Doleschall.

Euploea redtenbacheri, the Malayan crow or Redtenbacher's crow is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1865. It is found in the Indomalayan realm and the Australasian realm.
Nacaduba kurava, the transparent six-line blue, is a species of Lycaenidae butterfly found in Asia.
The pale daddy-long-leg, (Smeringopus pallidus), is a species of spider of the genus Smeringopus. It is a cosmopolitan species found in many countries.

Theridion zonulatum is a species of comb-footed spider in the family Theridiidae. It was first described by Tamerlan Thorell in 1890. The species is distributed across several countries in Asia, including India, China, Thailand, Singapore, and Indonesia.
Appias olferna, the eastern striped albatross or Bengal albatross, is a butterfly in the Appias genus of the family Pieridae.
Bactrocera umbrosa adalah spesies lalat yang tergolong famili Tephritidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Diptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.

Chrysomya megacephala, more commonly known as the oriental latrine fly, is a member of the family Calliphoridae (blowflies). It is a warm-weather fly with a greenish-blue metallic box-like body. The fly infests corpses soon after death, making it important to forensic science.
Euthalia amanda, the Sulawesi gaudy baron, is butterfly endemic to Sulawesi, Indonesia. It was first described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1862.

The Black looper, (Hyposidra talaca), also known as Black inch worm, is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in India to Indochina, Sundaland, Sulawesi, the Philippines, Sri Lanka, the Solomon Islands, Thailand, Taiwan, New Guinea and Australia, where it has been recorded from Queensland.
Orthomorpha coarctata atau dikenal dengan nama ulat gagak atau joyo gading adalah spesies kaki seribu dari famili Paradoxosomatidae. Hewan ini juga dikenal dengan nama long-flange millipede.

species.summary: The sweetpotato bug (Physomerus grossipes) is a species of hemipterans in the family Coreidae. Native to Southeast Asia, the species has immigrated to the Pacific Islands. Frequently laying its eggs on the same Leguminosae and Convolvulaceae plants on which it feeds, the female of P.
Rapala manea is a butterfly of the Lycaenidae family. It is found in most of the Indomalayan realm (excluding Taiwan).

The spiny-legged jumper, (Spartaeus spinimanus), is a species of spider of the genus Spartaeus. It is found from Sri Lanka to Borneo, and Sumbawa. The most preferred prey is moths, where the spider builds large sheet webs on tree trunks to capture them.
Allotinus unicolor, the lesser darkie, is a butterfly in the Lycaenidae family. It was described by Cajetan and Rudolf Felder in 1865. It is found in Asia.
Cabangus regius is a species of sea slug, a dendronotid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusc in the family Dendronotidae.

Deudorix epijarbas, the cornelian, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly found in South-East Asia from India to Fiji, including the Philippines, and also the tropical coast of Queensland in Australia.

Hymenopus coronatus adalah belalang dari hutan tropis Asia Tenggara. Hal ini dikenal dengan berbagai nama umum termasuk belalang bunga berjalan dan belalang anggrek (merah muda). Ini adalah salah satu dari beberapa spesies yang dikenal sebagai belalang bunga dari kemiripan dan perilakunya.
Idea stolli, the common tree nymph, is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is found in South East Asia. There are twelve Idea species, of which five occur in West Malaysia.

Leucauge granulata is one of the long-jawed orb weaver spiders. Found in India, Sri Lanka, China, Sunda Islands (Indonensia), also to Australia. Leucauge granulata marginata is known to inhabit New Guinea. Leucauge granulata rimitara in French Polynesia.

Lalat rumah (Musca domestica) adalah lalat dari subordo Cyclorrhapha. Lalat ini diyakini telah berevolusi dalam era Kenozoikum, mungkin di Timur Tengah, dan telah menyebar ke seluruh dunia sebagai spesies yang memiliki hubungan komensalisme dengan manusia.

Myrmarachne clavigera adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Myrmarachne dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1877 oleh Thorell.
Ricania speculum, common name Black planthopper or Ricaniid Planthopper, is a species of planthoppers belonging to the family Ricaniidae.

Stomopneustes variolaris, the black sea urchin or long-spined sea urchin, is a species of sea urchin, the only one in its genus Stomopneustes and only species still alive in its family Stomopneustidae. It is found throughout the tropical Indo-Pacific, with a patchy distribution.
Theridion quadratum, is a species of spider of the genus Theridion. It is found only in Sri Lanka and Sumatra.
Anthene emolus, the ciliate blue, is a small butterfly found in India and Southeast Asia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.

Eriovixia excelsa adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1889 oleh Simon.
Flos apidanus, the plain plushblue, is a small butterfly found in the Indomalayan realm that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Harpago chiragra, common name the Chiragra spider conch, is a species of very large sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs.
Leptotes plinius, the zebra blue or plumbago blue, is a species of blue butterfly (Lycaenidae) found in India.

species.name: Ulat Grayak
species.summary: Spodoptera litura, the tobacco cutworm or cotton leafworm, is a nocturnal species of moth. S. litura is a serious polyphagous pest in Asia, Oceania, and the Indian subcontinent described by Johan Christian Fabricius in 1775. Its names reference two of the most common host plants of the moth.
Acanthopleura gemmata, the Jewelled Chiton, is a species of chiton.
Euchromia horsfieldi is a species of moth in the subfamily Arctiinae first described by Frederic Moore in 1859. It is found on Java, Sumatra, Borneo, the Lesser Sunda Islands and Christmas Island.

species.name: Onga Jawa
species.summary: Radix rubiginosa is a species of air-breathing freshwater snail, an aquatic pulmonate gastropod in the family Lymnaeidae, the pond snails.

Zosis geniculata sometimes referred to as the humped spider or grey house spider, is a cosmopolitan species with a pantropical distribution. In Australia, it is often seen in buildings near human habitation.
Ampittia dioscorides, the common bush hopper or simply bush hopper, is a butterfly found in India, China, Indochina and on to Borneo, Sumatra and Java belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Anarrhotus is a genus of jumping spiders. The only described species Anarrhotus fossulatus is endemic to Malaysia.

Euploea sylvester, the double-branded crow, also known as the two-brand crow in Australia, is a butterfly found in South Asia, Southeast Asia and parts of Australia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
The Brown-striped semilooper, (Mocis undata), is a species of moth of the Erebidae family. It is found in the Afrotropical and Oriental Regions, including India and Sri Lanka.
Bipalium javanum, the Javan broadhead planarian, is a species of land planarian belonging to the subfamily Bipaliinae. It is endemic to Indonesia.
Chromodoris elisabethina is a species of very colourful sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Chromodorididae.

Condica illecta is a moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found in both the Indo-Australian and Pacific tropics, including Borneo, Hawaii, Hong Kong, India, New Guinea, the Society Islands, Taiwan and Queensland and New South Wales in Australia. It is also present in New Zealand.
Metasesarma obesum, also known as the marble crab or marble Batik crab, is a species of sesarmid crab. It is a semiterrestrial and brackish-water crab that lives on sandy beaches.
Parantica agleoides, the dark glassy tiger, is a butterfly found in India that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.

Physocyclus globosus, sometimes known as the short-bodied cellar spider is a species of spider belonging to the family Pholcidae. This is a cosmopolitan species, found in caves and buildings throughout the warmer parts of the world.
Pycnoscelus indicus is a species of cockroach in the genus Pycnoscelus, family Blaberidae.

The Surinam cockroach or greenhouse cockroach (Pycnoscelus surinamensis) is a species of burrowing cockroach. It is a common plant pest endemic to the Indomalayan region that has spread to tropical and into subtropical regions around the world, and in isolated populations to temperate climates where protective habitat…
Viciria pavesii is a species of jumping spider in the genus Viciria. It is the type species of the genus and is found across tropical Southeast Asia.

Kupu-kupu sayap oranye atau Appias nero (Inggris: Orange Albatross) adalah salah satu spesies kupu-kupu dari keluarga Pieridae. Spesies ini bisa ditemukan dari daerah India Utara, kepulauan Sunda, Filipina, dan Sulawesi.

Areas galactina is a moth of the family Erebidae. It was described by Hoeven in 1840. It is found in China (Sichuan, Hunan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, Hubei), Taiwan, the north-western Himalayas, India (Sikkim, Assam, Andamans), Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Indochina, the Philippines, Indonesia and Sundaland.

The Crotalaria pod borer (Argina astrea) is a moth of the Erebidae family. It is found in eastern Africa, southern Asia of India, Sri Lanka, and Indo-Australia, including the Pacific Islands and Australia.
Bactrocera albistrigata adalah spesies lalat yang tergolong famili Tephritidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Diptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Araneus mitificus, commonly known as the kidney garden spider or pale orb weaver is a species of orb-weaver spider found in South, East, and Southeast Asia.
Bradina diagonalis is a moth of the Crambidae family. It was described from Java, but is also found in Taiwan, China, Vietnam and Pakistan.

Bradybaena similaris, common name the Asian trampsnail, is a species of small, air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Bradybaenidae. It earned the common name based on its origins, and its habit of roosting on freight containers.
Cepora temena is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in Indonesia.
Ceratina smaragdula, also known as Ceratina (Pithitis) smaragdula, is a species of green metallic bees belonging to the family Apidae, subfamily Xylocopinae.
The Triangular-striped moth, Chalciope mygdon is a moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found from the Oriental region to Sundaland.

Delta esuriens is a species of potter wasp found in tropical Asia, belonging to the Vespidae family. They can be separated from the similar looking Delta pyriforme by the presence of a yellow band on the metasomal petiole segment.

Euploea tulliolus, the dwarf crow or small brown crow, is a butterfly found in the Solomon Islands, Malaysia, Taiwan, Vietnam, Singapore and Australia, that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family. It has a wingspan of about 4 to 8 centimeters....
Odoiporus longicollis (Penggerek batang pisang) adalah hama yang menyerang batang pohon pisang. Hama ini menyebar di daerah China, India, Indonesia, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, dan Thailand.

Polyura schreiber, the blue nawab, is a butterfly species found in tropical Asia. It belongs to the Charaxinae (rajahs and nawabs) in the brush-footed butterfly family (Nymphalidae). It occurs from south India and Assam through Myanmar, Tenasserim, and Southeast Asia to southern China and to Java, Indonesia.

Theretra silhetensis, the brown-banded hunter hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae described by Francis Walker in 1856. It lives in Indo-Australia, India, Sri Lanka, Papua New Guinea, East Australia, Solomon Islands, Fiji Islands, Vanuatu Islands.
Vagrans is monotypic genus with the species vagrant (Vagrans egista) a species of nymphalid butterfly found in forested areas of tropical South Asia and Southeast Asia.
Drupadia ravindra, common name common posy, is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae.
Graphium evemon, the blue jay, lesser jay, or pale green triangle is a species of tropical butterfly found in India, Indonesia, and Malaysia.
Harmonia sedecimnotata is a species of beetle in the family Coccinellidae. The species is found in southern China, eastern India, Nepal and Southeast Asia. The species is predatory.
Hycleus biundulatus is a species of blister beetle found in India, Sri Lanka, China, Java, and Pakistan.

Oxyopes shweta adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Oxyopidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Oxyopes dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1970 oleh Tikader.
Platydemus manokwari, also known as the New Guinea flatworm, is a species of large predatory land flatworm.
Vindula erota, the common cruiser, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in forested areas of tropical South Asia and Southeast Asia.
Cepora nerissa, the common gull, is a small to medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is native to India, China, Southeast Asia, and Indonesia.

Cytaea oreophila adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Cytaea dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1902 oleh Simon.

Bapak pucung kapas atau bapak pucung tanda tiga (bahasa Latin: Dysdercus cingulatus) adalah spesies dari kepik sejati dalam famili Pyrrhocoridae. Bapak pucung kapas merupakan hama bagi tanaman kapas. Nimfa dewasa dan tua memakan buah kapas yang muncul dan biji kapas yang akan matang.
Erebus ephesperis is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in Asia, including India, Japan, the Korean Peninsula, China, Singapore and Borneo.

The Green fruit-piercing moth, (Eudocima salaminia), is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found from India across south-east Asia to the Pacific Islands. In Australia it occurs in the Northern Territory, Queensland and New South Wales. Adult is a fruit-piercer.
Pergesa acteus, the green pergesa hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae described by Pieter Cramer in 1779.

Eupterote asclepiades is a moth in the family Eupterotidae. It was described by Swinhoe in 1894. It is found in Sundaland. The habitat consist of lowland rainforests, including hill dipterocarp forests.
Xylocopa caerulea, the blue carpenter bee, is a species of carpenter bee.
Aegus chelifer, is a species of stag beetle found in Indo-Malaya regional countries.

Fasciola gigantica is a parasitic flatworm of the class Trematoda, which causes tropical fascioliasis. It is regarded as one of the most important single platyhelminth infections of ruminants in Asia and Africa. Estimates of infection rates are as high as 80-100% in some countries.

Oriens gola, the common dartlet, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found from Sri Lanka and India (Kumaon, Sikkim, Assam) to Burma, Thailand, Vietnam, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo and Sumatra. The habitat consists of sunny glades and clearings in secondary forests and plantations.
Oxynopterus mucronatus, sometimes known as the giant click beetle, is a species of click beetle from tropical Southeast Asia. Their larvae are specialized predators of termites.

Paederus is a genus of small beetles of the family Staphylinidae ("rove beetles"). With 622 valid species assigned by 1987 to the subtribe Paederina (Paederus and its close allies), and with all but 148 within Paederus itself, the genus is large.

Phintella bifurcilinea is a species of jumping spider in the genus Phintella. Originally described by Bösenberg and Strand in 1906 as Telamonia bifurcilinea, it was transferred to the genus Phintella by Prószyński in 1983.

Potanthus omaha, commonly known as the lesser dart, is a species of skipper butterflies. It is found in Indochina, Malaysia, Singapore, the Philippines, and Sulawesi. It includes the following subspecies:
Antheraea jana is a moth of the family Saturniidae first described by Stoll in 1782. It is found in Sundaland, the Andamans and Myanmar.
Cethosia hypsea, the Malay lacewing, is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found in from Burma to Indonesia and the Philippines.

Cyrtophora exanthematica adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1859 oleh Doleschall.
Hypselodoris maculosa is a species of sea slug or dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Chromodorididae.

Myrmarachne cornuta adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Myrmarachne dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1918 oleh Badcock.
Phoroncidia testudo, is a species of spider of the genus Phoroncidia. It is native to India and Sri Lanka.
Psolos fuligo, the coon, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. The tips of the forewings diverge outward and is a feature that is clear when they rest on vegetation.
Rapala pheretima, the copper flash, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly found in Asia.
Thaumantis odana, Malayan Jungle Glory, is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Jean Baptiste Godart in 1824. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Daphnusa ocellaris, the durian hawkmoth, is a species of moth of the family Sphingidae.
Dysdercus decussatus, the fork-banded cotton bug, is a species of true bug in the family Pyrrhocoridae and genus Dysdercus.

Gea spinipes adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1843 oleh C L Koch.
Harpa major, common name large harp, or major harp, is a species of large predatory sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusks in the family Harpidae, the harp snails and their allies.

Ligurra latidens adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Ligurra dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1859 oleh Doleschall.
Nerita plicata is a species of tropical sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Neritidae, the nerites. This species is found throughout the Indo-West Pacific.
Nevrina procopia is a moth in the Crambidae family. It was described by Stoll in 1781. The type locality is unknown. It is found from Sri Lanka, India and Bhutan.
Papilio polytes, the common Mormon, is a common species of swallowtail butterfly widely distributed across Asia.
Synonycha grandis, commonly known as Giant bamboo ladybird, is a species of lady beetle found in Australia, Oceania and Southern Asia.
Tajuria cippus, the peacock royal, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly found in the Indomalayan realm....

Traminda aventiaria, the Cross-lined Notched Vestal Moth, is a species of moth in the family Geometridae. The species was first described by Achille Guenée in 1858. It is found in the Indian subregion, Sri Lanka, to Hong Kong, Taiwan, New Guinea and Australia.

Utetheisa pulchelloides (heliotrope moth) is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in the Indo-Australian region including Borneo, Hong Kong, New Zealand, Papua, Seychelles and most of Australia.
Argiope dang is a species of orb weaver spider in the family Araneidae. It was first described in 2009 and is found in Thailand and Laos.

Arthroschista hilaralis, also known as the kadam defoliator, is a moth in the Crambidae family. It was described by Walker in 1859. It is found in India, Sri Lanka, Burma, Cambodia, Sumatra, Borneo and in Australia, where it has been recorded from Queensland.

Bibasis sena, commonly known as the orange-tailed awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae, the skippers. It is also sometimes called the pale green awlet though that name can also refer to Bibasis gomata.
Deroplatys desiccata, known by the common names giant dead leaf mantis is a species of praying mantis from Southeast Asia.

Dichorragia nesmachus, the constable, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Asia. The genus was earlier considered to belong to the subfamily Cyrestinae and sometimes the Apaturinae, but is now considered as an sister of the genus Stibochiona in the subfamily Pseudergolinae.
Elymnias casiphone is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by Carl Geyer in 1827. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Eooxylides tharis, the branded imperial, is a butterfly in the Lycaenidae family. It was described by Carl Geyer in 1837. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.

Euploea westwoodii, or Westwood's king crow, is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1865. It is found in the Celebes in the Australasian realm.
Hypochrosis hyadaria is a geometer moth in the Ennominae subfamily. The species has a wide range from India, Sri Lanka through Southeast Asia.
Libythea myrrha, the club beak, is a butterfly found in India that belongs to the Libytheinae group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Melanitis zitenius, the great evening brown, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Asia. The species is crepuscular.

species.name: Gangsir
species.summary: Gangsir (Tarbinskiellus portentosus, sin. Brachytrupes portentosus) adalah sejenis jangkrik besar yang hidup dengan menggali lubang di tanah. Jangkrik ini berpotensi sebagai hama tanaman pertanian, tetapi juga acap ditangkap untuk dikonsumsi orang.

The Triangles, (Trigonodes hyppasia), also known as semi-looper is a moth formerly of the Noctuidae family. It is largely cosmopolitan, found throughout Borneo, Fiji, India, Sri Lanka, São Tomé and Príncipe, Taiwan, Zimbabwe, Northern Australia, and almost all African countries.
Tuerkayana hirtipes is a species of terrestrial crab.
Anthene lycaenina, the pointed ciliate blue, is a small butterfly found in India that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Callidula sakuni is a moth of the family Callidulidae. It is found in Sundaland, Burma and Thailand.

Cepora perimale, the caper gull, is a butterfly in the Pieridae family. It is found on Norfolk Island and in New South Wales, the Northern Territory, Queensland, Victoria, Western Australia, Fiji, Irian Jaya, Maluku, Sulawesi, New Caledonia, Papua New Guinea, the Solomon Islands and Vanuatu.
Cethosia penthesilea, the orange lacewing, is a species of heliconiine butterfly found in Southeast Asia, as well as the Australia's Northern Territory.

Chelisoches morio, commonly known as the black earwig, is a cosmopolitan earwig in the family Chelisochidae. Black earwigs are active at all times of the day, and prefer wet habitats. Adults can grow up to 36 millimetres (1.4 in).
Eurema sari, the chocolate grass yellow, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in Southeast Asia.
Halgerda carlsoni is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, shell-less marine gastropod mollusks in the family Discodorididae.

The sugarcane looper (Mocis frugalis) is a species of moth of the Erebidae family. It is found in several parts of the world, including India, Sri Lanka, West African countries and other Oriental regions. Adult is a fruit-piercer and a major pest throughout the crops.
Nesticodes is a genus of spiders in the family Theridiidae. It was first described in 1950 by Archer. As of 2017, it contains only one species, Nesticodes rufipes, the red house spider.

Nyctemera adversata is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, India, Nepal, Myanmar, China territories like Tibet, Sichuan, Yunnan, Guangdong, Hong Kong, Hainan, Guangxi, Hunan, Henan, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian, Taiwan, Japan (northern part of Honshu Island), Peninsular Malaysia, Thailand,…
Sicyopterus squamosissimus is a species of fish in the goby family Oxudercidae. It is found off the islands of Sumatra and Java in Indonesia.
Bactrocera carambolae adalah spesies lalat yang tergolong famili Tephritidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Diptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Belionota aenea is a Jewel Beetle of the Buprestidae family.

Caerostris sumatrana adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1915 oleh Strand.

Cosmophasis gemmans adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Cosmophasis dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1890 oleh Thorell.

Cyana perornata is a moth of the family Erebidae. It was described by Walker in 1854. It is found in India (Sikkim, Assam) and Sundaland. The habitat consists of lowland forests, extending more weakly into lower montane forests.

Elibia dolichus is a moth of the Sphingidae family . It is found in Nepal, north-eastern India, Bangladesh, Thailand, southern China, Malaysia (Peninsular, Sarawak, Sabah), Indonesia (Sumatra, Kalimantan, Java) to the Philippines (Palawan Island).

Eucorynus crassicornis is a species of fungus weevil in the beetle family Anthribidae, which was first described in 1801 by Johan Christian Fabricius as Anthribus crassicornis, from specimen(s) collected in Sumatra.

Hippotion rosetta is a species of Sphingid moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found from southern Pakistan, India and Sri Lanka, east across Thailand, southern China and Taiwan to southern Japan (the Ryukyu Archipelago) and the Philippines, then south across south-east Asia to the Andaman Islands, eastern Indonesia,…
Nacaduba beroe, the opaque six-line blue, is a species of lycaenid butterfly found in South Asia.
Neopithecops zalmora, the Quaker, is a small butterfly found in South Asia and Southeast Asia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.

Prooedema is a genus of moths of the Crambidae family. It contains only one species, Prooedema inscisalis, which is found in India, China, Indonesia, the Philippines, Papua New Guinea and Australia, where it has been recorded from the Northern Territory and Queensland.
Reticulidia halgerda is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusk in the family Phyllidiidae.
Scolopendra morsitans, also known as the Tanzanian blue ringleg or red-headed centipede, is a species of centipede in the family Scolopendridae.
Serrognathus taurus is a species of beetle belonging to the family Lucanidae which was described by Johan Christian Fabricius in 1801.

Tetraponera rufonigra, is a species of ant belonging to the subfamily Pseudomyrmecinae. It is distributed across Asia, and Africa. Commonly called the Bi-coloured Arboreal ant, they are arboreal and build small nests which are excavated holes usually in dried parts of trees.

species.name: Ketam Kampat
species.summary: Kepiting kampat atau ketam kampat (Varuna litterata) adalah sejenis ketam pantai, anggota suku Varunidae. Ketam ini umumnya hidup di laut dekat pantai, muara sungai, tetapi juga dapat memasuki perairan sungai berair tawar hingga cukup jauh ke pedalaman.
Amphilophus labiatus is a large cichlid fish endemic to Lake Managua and Lake Nicaragua in Central America.
Amyciaea forticeps is a species of ant-mimicking crab spider in the family Thomisidae. It is found across Asia, ranging from India and China to Malaysia.
Badamia exclamationis, commonly known as the brown awl or narrow-winged awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae, which is found in India, Southeast Asia, Australia, and Oceania.

Bibasis gomata, commonly known as the pale green awlet, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. It is found in Northeast India, the Western Ghats and parts of Southeast Asia. The butterfly was reassigned to genus Burara by Vane-Wright and de Jong (2003) and is considered by them to be Burara gomata.
Borbo cinnara, commonly known as the rice swift or Formosan swift, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. It is found in Sri Lanka, India, Burma, Vietnam and Australia.
Carrhotus sannio is a species of jumping spider in the family Salticidae. It is found across a wide range in Asia, from southern China to India, Indonesia and Guam.

Carrhotus viduus adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Carrhotus dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1846 oleh C L Koch.

Cephonodes hylas, the coffee bee hawkmoth, pellucid hawk moth or coffee clearwing, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. A widely distributed moth, it is found in the Near East, Middle East, Africa, India, Sri Lanka, Japan, Southeast Asia and Australia.
Chalybion bengalense, also known as the oriental mud dauber, is a widely distributed member of the Chalybion genus. Melittobia assemi has been reported as a parasite of this species.
Eurydema dominulus, also known by its common name painted bug, is a cabbage bug from the genus Eurydema. The species was first described in 1763.
Hasora badra, the common awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae, which is found in India.
Heterocentrotus trigonarius, commonly known as the slate pencil urchin or red slate pencil urchin, is found in the tropical waters of the Indo-Pacific region.

Hyllus semicupreus adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Hyllus dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1885 oleh Simon.
Hypolimnas antilope, the spotted crow eggfly, is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found from Malaya to the Philippines, New Guinea and Australia.
Leucauge argentina is a species of long-jawed orb weaver in the family Tetragnathidae. It was first described by van Hasselt in 1882 as Theridion argentinum from Sumatra, Indonesia.
Megachile opposita is a species of bee in the family Megachilidae. It was described by Smith in 1853.
Athyma pravara, the unbroken sergeant, is a species of brush-footed butterfly found in tropical and subtropical Asia.

species.name: Kerang Hijau
species.summary: Perna viridis (Asian green mussel) is an economically important mussel, a bivalve belonging to the family Mytilidae. It is harvested for food but is also known to harbor toxins and cause damage to submerged structures such as drainage pipes.
Steatoda cingulata is a species of cobweb spider in the family Theridiidae. It is widely distributed across Asia, ranging from India and China to Japan, Korea, and Southeast Asia.

Tetragonus catamitus, the common butterfly moth, or Philippine callidulid moth, is a moth of the family Callidulidae. Noted from Taiwan, north-eastern India, south-west India, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Sri Lanka, the Tenasserim Hills of Burma and from Java.

Theretra clotho is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found from Sri Lanka, India (including the Andaman Islands), Nepal and Myanmar, east through China to Taiwan, South Korea and Japan, and then south-east through South East Asia as far as the Lesser Sunda Islands and Timor in Indonesia.

Antheraea assamensis, the muga silkworm as larva and Assam silkmoth as an adult, is a moth of the family Saturniidae. The species was first described by T. W. Helfer in 1837. It is found in Assam in northeast India where 99% of its production occurs.
Diacrotricha fasciola (starfruit flowermoth) is a moth of the family Pterophoridae. It is widely distributed throughout south-east Asia.

Belalang kembara (Locusta migratoria) adalah jenis belalang besar yang paling tersebar di dunia, dan merupakan satu-satunya spesies anggota marga Locusta. Serangga hama ini dapat dijumpai di seluruh Dunia Lama yang beriklim agak hangat, mulai dari Afrika, Asia, Australia, sampai Selandia Baru.
Nematogmus dentimanus, is a species of spider of the genus Nematogmus. It is found from Sri Lanka to Malaysia, Java, Krakatau.

Papilio palinurus, the emerald swallowtail, emerald peacock or green-banded peacock, is a butterfly of the genus Papilio belonging to the Papilionidae family. It is native to Southeast Asia, but is regularly kept in butterfly houses around the world.
Rhombodera stalii is a species of praying mantises in the family Mantidae, found on the island of Java in Indonesia.

species.name: Kumbang Tanduk Merah
species.summary: Kumbang sagu atau Kumbang kelapa merah atau Kumbang tanduk merah (Lat.: Rhynchophorus ferrugineus, larvanya disebut ulat sagu) adalah jenis kumbang yang tersebar luas dari India sampai Sauwa, mengikuti penyebaran inangnya. Tubuh berwarna coklat kemerahan atau hitam,sebesar kenari.

The fall armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda) is a species the order of Lepidoptera and is the larval life stage of a fall armyworm moth. It is regarded as a pest and can damage and destroy a wide variety of crops, causing large economic damage.

The Lily caterpillar, (Spodoptera picta), is a moth of the family Noctuidae. It was described by Guérin-Méneville in 1838. It is found in the Oriental Region of India, Sri Lanka, Australia, and Japan.

species.name: Sumpil
species.summary: Subulina octona is a species of small, tropical, air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Subulinidae.
Tenodera fasciata is a species of mantis in the subfamily Mantinae of the family Mantidae.

Acalolepta rusticatrix adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang berasal dari famili Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Acalolepta, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.

The horehound bug (Agonoscelis rutila) is a stink bug which sucks the sap of the horehound plant, causing wilting of new shoots. They have five nymphal stages in their development. Although they usually attack horehound, they may also swarm on a variety of other trees and shrubs.

Anepsion depressum adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Anepsion dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1877 oleh Thorell.

Anepsion maritatum adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Anepsion dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1877 oleh O P-Cambridge.
Anoplodesmus saussurii, is a species of millipedes in the family Paradoxosomatidae. It was once thought endemic to Sri Lanka, but later found from Fiji and Mauritius....
Arestorides argus, common name : the eyed cowrie, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

Chikunia bilde is a species of comb-footed spider in the family Theridiidae. It is found in Malaysia, Singapore, and Indonesia. The Chikunia bilde was first discovered in 2019 by researchers and is described as being unusually tolerant of human activity.

Dysphania militaris is a species of moth of the Geometridae family that is found from in the tropical regions of South and Southeast Asian countries such as China, Assam, Myanmar, Andaman Islands, Sumatra and Java.
Elymnias dara is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by William Burgess Pryer and William Lucas Distant in 1887. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
The banner, (Eublemma anachoresis), is a species of moth of the Erebidae family. It is found in the Indomalaya ecozone, Australia and the southern part of Africa.
Gandaca harina, the tree yellow, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in India, Thailand, Cambodia, Myanmar, Malaysia, Singapore, Philippines, and Indonesia.
Marumba dyras, the dull swirled hawkmoth, is a species of hawk moth described by Edmund Murton Walker in 1856. It is found in South-east and South Asia.

images.credit: Alan Kwok (King Lun), Ada Tai (Ah Heung) / 阿達蘭 AdAlan

species.summary: Trichomyrmex destructor is a species of ant in the subfamily Myrmicinae. Its common names include destructive trailing ant or Singapore ant. It is a pest species in urban areas, known for causing costly damage to structures, vehicles, and electronic devices with its chewing activity.

Myrmarachne melanocephala adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Myrmarachne dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1839 oleh MacLeay.
Oxyopes javanus is a species of lynx spider in the family Oxyopidae. It was first described by Tamerlan Thorell in 1887 and is widely distributed across South and Southeast Asia.
Phycosoma hana is a species of spider in the family Theridiidae. It was described from China, where it is known from Hainan Island.
Pingasa ruginaria is a species of moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in northern India, south-east Asia, the Ryukyu Islands and Sundaland.
Polistes stigma is a species of paper wasp from Southeast Asia.
Pontoscolex corethrurus is an earthworm in the genus Pontoscolex. It has a circumtropical distribution, although it originates in the Neotropics, probably in the Guiana Plateau.
Rapala varuna, the indigo flash, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly found in the Indomalayan realm and the Australasian realm.

Scytodes fusca, the brown spitting spider, is a species of spitting spider in the family Scytodidae. It is found in Central and Southern America, has been introduced into Europe, tropical Africa, Seychelles, Myanmar, China, Japan, and Hawaii.
Telicota colon, commonly known as the pale palm dart or pale-orange darter, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.

Aiolopus thalassinus is a species of grasshopper belonging to the family Acrididae, subfamily Oedipodinae. It is present in most countries of Europe, in the Afrotropic ecozone to Asia and the Pacific islands.
Amnosia decora, the Ninja, is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae (Pseudergolinae). It is found in the Indomalayan realm. It is the sole member of the monotypic genus Amnosia.
Antheraea larissa is a silkworm moth of the family Saturniidae found in Sundaland. The species was first described by Westwood in 1847. The larva feed on the endangered tree Shorea glauca.

species.name: Sapi
species.summary: Sapi, jawi atau lembu adalah hewan ternak anggota famili Bovidae dan subfamili Bovinae. Sapi dipelihara terutama untuk dimanfaatkan susu dan dagingnya sebagai pangan manusia. Hasil sampingannya seperti kulit, jeroan, tanduk, dan kotorannya juga dimanfaatkan untuk berbagai keperluan manusia.

Comostola pyrrhogona is a moth of the family Geometridae described by Francis Walker in 1866. It is found in the Indo-Australian tropics from India, Sri Lanka to Taiwan, and east to Vanuatu, New Caledonia, northern Australia and Norfolk Island.
Delias momea is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by Jean Baptiste Boisduval in 1836 . It is endemic to Sumatra and Java in the Indomalayan realm.
Hierodula dyaka is a species of praying mantis in the family Mantidae.

Ischiodon scutellaris, commonly known as the common hover fly or yellow-shouldered hover fly, is a species of hover fly found in India, Turkey to Japan and Australia, as well as all the Pacific islands except for Hawaii.
Ligyra tantalus adalah spesies lalat yang berasal dari genus Ligyra dan famili Bombyliidae. Lalat ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Diptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Ourapteryx claretta is a moth of the Geometridae family. It is found in Sundaland.

Phaeacius fimbriatus adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Phaeacius dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1900 oleh Simon.

Poltys illepidus is a species of spider in the family Araneidae. It was first described by C. L. Koch in 1843. The species is distributed across northern Australia, Papua New Guinea, and Southeast Asia, extending north to Thailand and Japan.
Pompelon is a monotypic moth genus in the family Zygaenidae erected by Francis Walker in 1854. Its only species, Pompelon marginata, was first described by Félix Édouard Guérin-Méneville in 1843.
Rhysida longipes, sometimes known as Minor blue leg, is a species of centipedes in the family Scolopendridae. Three subspecies recognized. It is sometimes used as a pet in some countries.
Abroscelis longipes is a species of tiger beetle in the genus Abroscelis.

Acusilas malaccensis adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Acusilas dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1983 oleh Murphy Murphy.
Aethaloessa calidalis is a moth of the Crambidae family. It is found throughout the Seychelles, South and South-East Asia, Australia and on many Pacific islands.

Agrioglypta eurytusalis is a moth in the Crambidae family. It is found in southern India, Sri Lanka, Borneo, Cambodia, Thailand, Taiwan, Japan and Australia, where it has been recorded from northern Queensland.
Ahaetulla rufusoculara, the red-eyed vine snake, is a species of snake in the family Colubridae. It is endemic to Vietnam where it is known from the Sóc Trăng province.
Calliteara horsfieldii, or Horsfield's tussock moth, is a moth of the family Erebidae. The species was first described by Saunders in 1851.

Charon grayi, the giant whip-spider, is a species of whip spider found in Malaysia, Singapore, Philippines, Indonesia, Papua New Guinea, the Solomon Islands and Palau. This whip-spider usually lives in caves.
Choreutis basalis is a species of moth of the family Choreutidae. It is found in eastern Queensland, from Cape York to Yeppoon. It is also present in New Guinea and Indonesia.

Cylas formicarius (Hama boleng)adalah hama yang diperkirakan berasal dari Afrika atau India. Hama ini menyerang ubi jalar dan dapat menghilangkan hasil panen hingga 100%. Larva serangga ini menyerang umbi dan membuat umbi menjadi berlubang dan terasa pahit.

Cyrtarachne nagasakiensis adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1918 oleh Strand.

Graphium aristeus, the chain swordtail, is a butterfly in the family Papilionidae (swallowtails). It is found in the Indomalaya ecozone. The Indian subspecies G. a. anticrates is protected by law in India. It is found in Sikkim, Bhutan, Meghalaya, West Bengal and Assam.
Graptostethus servus is a species of seed bug in the family Lygaeidae. It is found in Europe, Asia, Australia, and in the Pacific region. Larvae are grey and are prey items for chickens.
Harmonia octomaculata (the large spotted ladybird) is a species of ladybird (the family Coccinellidae). Found in India, Pakistan, Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Micronesia, and Australia.
Hulodes caranea is a species of moth of the Erebidae family. It is found from India, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Java, Hong Kong to Queensland and New Guinea, it is also found on the Marianas and Carolines.
Illeis is a genus of ladybird beetles in the family Coccinellidae. There are about five described species in Illeis, found in south and east Asia and in Oceania.

Meandrusa payeni, the yellow gorgon, is a species of swallowtail found in parts of South Asia and Southeast Asia. It belongs to the hooked swallowtails genus, Meandrusa, of the family Papilionidae. It is also called the outlet sword or the sickle.
Micropholcus fauroti is a cellar spider species with Pantropical distribution. It has been introduced in Belgium and Germany.
Papilio paris, the Paris peacock, is a species of swallowtail butterfly found in the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia.
Pardosa sumatrana is a species of wolf spider in the family Lycosidae. It was first described by Tamerlan Thorell in 1890 from specimens collected in Sumatra.
Prosopocoilus astacoides is a beetle of the Family Lucanidae.
Prothoe franck, the blue begum, is a butterfly species found in Assam in north-eastern India and throughout a large part of South-East Asia.

Pystira ephippigera adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Pystira dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1885 oleh Simon.

Scolopendra dehaani, the giant Vietnamese centipede, is a large scolopendrid centipede found across Mainland Southeast Asia. It is also found in India, Japan, Hong Kong, and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

Scylla serrata atau yang juga dikenal sebagai kepiting-bakau besar (giant mangrove crab, giant mud crab) adalah sejenis kepiting bakau yang menyebar luas mulai dari pantai-pantai Asia Timur, Tenggara, Selatan, hingga ke Laut Merah. Spesies ini tidak didapati di perairan Dangkalan Sunda....
Terebellum terebellum, common name the Terebellum conch, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Seraphsidae, the true conchs.

Trabala vishnou, the rose-myrtle lappet moth, is a moth of the Lasiocampidae family. It is found in south-east Asia, including India, Thailand, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Java, China, Japan, Hong Kong, and Indonesia. Four subspecies are recognized.
Trypanophora semihyalina is a species of moth in the Zygaenidae family. It is found in south-east Asia, including India and China.
Aloa laetata (red costate tiger moth) is a moth of family Erebidae. It is found in India, Japan, southern and western China, Taiwan, Java, Sumatra, Sri Lanka, Burma and the Philippines.
Angaria delphinus, common name the common delphinula, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc of the family Angariidae.
Appias ada, the rare albatross, is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found on the Moluccas, New Guinea, Indonesia, Australia and the Solomon Islands.
Callidula jucunda is a moth of the family Callidulidae. It is endemic to Sundaland, a biogeographical region of Southeastern Asia.
Cecidochares connexa adalah spesies lalat yang tergolong famili Tephritidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Diptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Comostola laesaria is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in Sri Lanka, India, Indochina, southern China, Taiwan, Sundaland, northern Australia and the Bismarck Archipelago.

Corinnomma severum is a species of spider in the family Corinnidae. It has a wide distribution across Asia, ranging from India to China, and extending through the Philippines and parts of Indonesia including Sumatra and Sulawesi.

Culex quinquefasciatus Say, 1823 (originally named Culex fatigans), commonly known as the southern house mosquito, is a medium-sized mosquito found in tropical and subtropical regions of the world. It is the vector of Wuchereria bancrofti, avian malaria, and arboviruses including St.

Erebus macrops is a species of moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in the subtropical regions of Africa and Asia. The wingspan is about 12 cm, making it exceptionally large for an Erebidae species. The larvae feed on Acacia and Entada species.
Euploea crameri, the spotted black crow, is a butterfly found in Asia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the Danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.

Gasteracantha irradiata adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1842 oleh Walckenaer.
Gastrimargus marmoratus is a species of band-winged grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in southern Africa, Indomalaya, and eastern Asia.
Hasora taminatus, the white banded awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae, which is found in Asia.

Neoscona punctigera adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1857 oleh Doleschall.

Orgyia postica, the cocoa tussock moth or hevea tussock moth, is a species of moth of the Lymantriinae subfamily of family Erebidae found from the Oriental tropics of India, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Borneo, Java, New Guinea and Taiwan. It was described by Francis Walker in 1855.
Athyma selenophora, the staff sergeant, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in tropical and subtropical Asia.

species.name: Rajungan Biasa
species.summary: Rajungan biasa, rajungan bunga, atau rajungan biru (Portunus pelagicus) adalah sejenis kepiting yang hidup di laut. Jenis ini biasanya ditemukan di wilayah pantai yang dangkal, terutama di perairan Samudra Pasifik bagian barat.

Sameodes cancellalis is a species of moth of the Crambidae family. It has a wide distribution and has been recorded from India, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Burma, Thailand, Indochina, Taiwan, Japan, China, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, New Guinea, western and southern Africa, Fiji, the Cook Islands and Australia (Queensl…
Neritina turrita is a species of aquatic snail, a gastropod mollusk in the family Neritidae.

Xylocopa fenestrata, or Xylocopa (Ctenoxylocopa) fenestrata, is a species of carpenter bee. It is widely distributed in Asian countries and very few African countries such as Madagascar and Seychelles. It is considered as a pest of timber and bamboo, but is also a valuable pollinator.

Xystrocera globosa adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong familia Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Xystrocera, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.

Acosmeryx shervillii, the dull forest hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found from the Indian subregion of India, Sri Lanka, to Sundaland, the Philippines and Sulawesi. Acosmeryx pseudonaga is sometimes treated as a valid species.
Amphidromus porcellanus is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Camaenidae.
Antheraea helferi is a moth of the family Saturniidae first described by Frederic Moore in 1858. It is found in the north-eastern Himalaya and Sundaland.
Kecoak jerman (Blattella germanica) adalah sebuah spesies kecoak kecil, umumnya memiliki panjang sekitar 1,1 hingga 1,6 cm (0,43 hingga 0,63 in). Warna bervariasi dari cokelat hingga hampir hitam.

Burmattus albopunctatus adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Burmattus dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1895 oleh Thorell.
Curinus coeruleus is a species of beetle of the family Coccinellidae. It is found in South America (including Brazil) and was introduced to India, Thailand, Indonesia, Hawaii and the Philippines.

Cybister tripunctatus, is a species of predaceous diving beetle found in India, Andaman Nicobar Islands, Sri Lanka, Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Nepal, Pakistan, Bhutan, China, Cyprus, Iran, Iraq, Japan, Kyrgyzstan, Mongolia, Russia, Syria, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Italy, Turkey, Uzbekistan and Europe.

Cyclosia papilionaris, Drury's jewel, is a moth in the family Zygaenidae. It was described by Dru Drury in 1773. It is found from Thailand to southern China. The habitat consists of rainforests and humid deciduous forests at altitudes up to 1,000 meters.

Lyclene reticulata is a species of lichen moths of the Erebidae family, Arctiinae subfamily. It is found in Queensland, Australia, as well as on Ambon, Seram, Timor, Batchian, Aru, Tobriand, the Louisiade Archipelago and the Dampier Archipelago,

Cyrtophora cylindroides adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1842 oleh Walckenaer.
Eumorphus quadriguttatus, the four spotted handsome fungus beetle, is a species of handsome fungus beetle found in India, Andaman Islands, Sri Lanka and Korea.
Gangara thyrsis, commonly known as the giant redeye, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. It breeds on a number of palm species.
Graphium macareus, the lesser zebra, is a relatively common and not threatened species of swallowtail butterfly found in Southeast Asia. It is also found in parts of India including Assam and Sikkim.

Gryllus bimaculatus is one of many cricket species known as field crickets. Also known as the African or Mediterranean field cricket or as the two-spotted cricket, it can be discriminated from other Gryllus species by the two dot-like marks on the base of its wings.
Ideopsis gaura, the smaller wood nymph, is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is found in Southeast Asia.

Iridomyrmex anceps is an ant species of the Iridomyrmex genus. It has a very large distribution in multiple continents, but it is mainly distributed in northern Australia. Some specimens were found in multiple islands, and some were even found and collected in the United Arab Emirates.

species.name: Ketam bulan
species.summary: Matuta victor, atau disebut juga kepiting bulan atau ketam bulan, adalah sejenis kepiting kecil anggota suku Matutidae yang umum dijumpai.

Megacorma obliqua is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sri Lanka, north-eastern India, Myanmar, south-western China (Yunnan, Hainan), Thailand, northern Vietnam, Malaysia (Peninsular, Sarawak, Sabah), Indonesia (Sumatra, Kalimantan, Java, Ceram, Papua Barat), the Philippines (including Palawan), Papua N…
Nerita albicilla, common name the blotched nerite, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Neritidae.

The Portuguese man o' war (Physalia physalis), also known as the man-of-war or bluebottle, is a marine hydrozoan found in the Atlantic Ocean and the Indian Ocean. It was once thought that there was only one species in the genus Physalia, which in turn would make it the only genus in the family Physaliidae.
Rhipicephalus sanguineus merupakan ektoparasit umum yang sering menyerang anjing. Ektoparasit ini masuk dalam golongan caplak, sering dikelirukan dengan sebutan kutu.

Symmoracma is a genus of moths of the Crambidae family. It contains only one species, Symmoracma minoralis, which is found in Indonesia (Java, Sumbawa), Papua New Guinea, Taiwan, China and Australia, where it has been recorded from Queensland.
Tachypompilus analis, the red-tailed spider wasp is a species of spider wasp found in most of tropical and subtropical Asia, north to Japan. These spider wasps often hunt huntsman spiders.

Tenodera aridifolia is a species of mantis in the subfamily Mantinae. Common names include Japanese giant mantis, オオカマキリ oo-kamakiri ("large mantis") in Japan. It is also known as the Chinese mantis, not to be confused with Tenodera sinensis, which has the same common name. T.
Thaumantis klugius is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Johann Zincken in 1831. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Utetheisa lotrix (salt-and-pepper moth) is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in most of the old world tropics.
Antheraea helferi is a moth of the family Saturniidae first described by Frederic Moore in 1858. It is found in the north-eastern Himalaya and Sundaland.
Calappa hepatica is a common benthic species of box crab of tropical and subtropical parts of the Indian and Pacific Oceans and the Red Sea.

Catacanthus ("having downward-pointing thorns") is a genus of insects within the Pentatomidae family. The insects belonging to this genus are found in Madagascar, India, Sri Lanka, Burma, Thailand, China, Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Papua New Guinea, New Caledonia, Japan and South Korea.

Cephrenes trichopepla, the yellow palm dart, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found in Australia (the south-eastern coast of New South Wales, the northern Gulf and northern coast of the Northern Territory, the northern Gulf and northern coast of Queensland and the northern coast of Western Australia), Pa…

Kupu-kupu biblis atau Cethosia biblis adalah salah satu spesies kupu-kupu subfamili Heliconiinae yang termasuk dari famili Nymphalidae. Spesies ini tersebar di bagian timur Anak Benua India hingga ke Asia Tenggara dan Asia Timur. Batas paling timur hingga Filipina dan batas paling selatan hingga Indonesia.
Chondracris rosea is a species of large grasshopper in the family Cyrtacanthacridinae (tribe Cyrtacanthacridini); with a recorded distribution including: India, China, Indo-China and Malesia, Taiwan.
Cirrochroa emalea, the malay yeoman, is an Indomalayan species of heliconiine butterfly described by Félix Édouard Guérin-Méneville in 1843.
Cosmophasis ombria is a species of jumping spider in the family Salticidae. It was originally described as Maevia ombria by Tamerlan Thorell in 1877.

Cosmopolites sordidus (juga dikenali sebagai penggerek bonggol pisang atau kumbang pisang) adalah spesies kumbang moncong yang memakan tanaman pisang.
