species.summary: Glenea camilla is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Francis Polkinghorne Pascoe in 1867.

Glenea novemguttata is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Félix Édouard Guérin-Méneville in 1831, originally under the genus Sphenura. It is known from Malaysia, Java and Sumatra.

Glossodoris cincta is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusk in the family Chromodorididae. This name has been extensively used for a group of similarly coloured species, some of which are un-named.
Halolaguna biferrinella is a moth in the family Lecithoceridae. It is found in Malaysia and Indonesia.
Halpe zema, the zema banded ace, is a species of skipper, a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. It is native to Nepal, India, and Myanmar.
Harpegnathos venator is a species of ant found in South and Southeast Asia. It is found in northern India and parts of Burma.
Hasora vitta, the plain banded awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in India and parts of Southeast Asia.

Helopeltis antonii, also known as the tea mosquito bug, are heteropterans found within the Miridae family. They have a relatively large geographical distribution and are a known pest of many agricultural “cash” crops such as cocoa, cashew, and tea.
Henosepilachna septima, is a species of lady beetle found in Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, India, Sri Lanka and Pakistan.
Heterotrigona itama adalah spesies lebah tanpa sengat dari famili Apidae yang tersebar luas di Asia Tenggara, termasuk Indonesia.
Horaga syrinx, the yellow onyx, is a species of lycaenid or hairstreak butterfly found in Asia.

Hyposemansis singha is a species of moth in the family Erebidae. The specices is found in the Himalayas, Taiwan, Burma and on Borneo and Sumatra. The habitat consists of forests, ranging from the lowlands to altitudes of about 1,760 meters, but is mostly found in lowland dipterocarp forests.

Idea hypermnestra is a large butterfly that belongs to the danaid group of the family Nymphalidae. It was described by John Obadiah Westwood in 1848. It is found in the Indomalayan realm. It is found in Thailand and Malaysia.
Ixias pyrene, the yellow orange tip, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is found in India and Southeast Asia.
Jamides parasaturatus is a butterfly of the family Lycaenidae. It is found in Sumatra and Peninsular Malaysia.
Lethe chandica, the angled red forester, is a species of Satyrinae butterfly found in the Indomalayan realm.
Lethe rohria, the common treebrown, is a species of satyrine butterfly found in Asia.
Leucophlebia lineata, the large candy-striped hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It was described by John O. Westwood in 1847.
The species Lucilia cuprina, formerly named Phaenicia cuprina, is more commonly known as the Australian sheep blowfly.
Lunella cinerea, common name the smooth moon turban, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Turbinidae, the turban snails.
Eilema nubeculoides is a moth of the Arctiidae family. It is found in Malaysia.
The Mahathala ameria, the falcate oakblue, is a species of blue butterfly, of the family Lycaenidae found in South-East Asia.
Matapa druna, the grey-brand redeye, is a butterfly in the family Hesperiidae. It is found from Sikkim to northern Vietnam, China, Borneo and Bali.
Maxates coelataria is a moth of the Geometridae family. It is found in Sri Lanka, Indian Subregion to Sundaland.
Megachile laticeps is a species of bee in the family Megachilidae. It was described by Smith in 1853.
Meghimatium bilineatum is a species of gastropod belonging to the family Philomycidae.
Myrmecophilus americanus is an ant cricket, a wingless cricket that is an obligate parasite of ants and lives in their nests.
Nesogaster aculeatus is an earwig in the genus Nesogaster native to the Philippines, New Guinea, and Australia.
Nola lucidalis is a moth of the family Nolidae first described by Francis Walker in 1864. It is found in the Indian subregion, Sri Lanka, Borneo, Java, the Philippines and Taiwan.

Notocrypta curvifascia, the restricted demon, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. N. curvifascia is commonly found in many regions of temperate and tropical East Asia, Indonesia, and the Indian subcontinent, wherever its preferred larval host plant, Alpinia nutans can be found.

Ochetellus glaber (also known as the black household ant) is a species of ant native to Australia. A member of the genus Ochetellus in the subfamily Dolichoderinae, it was described by Austrian entomologist Gustav Mayr in 1862. Aside from Australia, O.

Ordgarius sexspinosus is a species of spider in the orb-weaver spider family Araneidae, found from India to Japan and Indonesia. O. sexspinosus is a bolas spider. Rather than using a web, adult females catch their prey by using a line with one or two sticky drops (a "bolas") which they swing.

The blue tilapia or Israeli tilapia, Oreochromis aureus, is a species of fish in the Cichlidae family. Native to Northern and Western Africa, and the Middle East, through introductions it is now also established elsewhere, including parts of the United States, where it has been declared an invasive species and has caus…
Pachynoa purpuralis is a moth in the Crambidae family. It was described by Francis Walker in 1866. It is found in Indonesia (Java), Thailand, West Malaysia, Borneo, Sumatra and the Philippines.

Palpifer sordida is a moth of the family Hepialidae. It was described by Pieter Cornelius Tobias Snellen in 1900. It is found in Java, Indonesia. Food plants for this species include Alocasia, Amorphophallus, and Dioscorea.
Pangaeus bilineatus, the peanut burrower bug, is a species of burrowing bug in the family Cydnidae. It is found in the Caribbean, Central America, and North America.

Papilio (Chilasa) paradoxa, the great blue mime, is a swallowtail butterfly found in India and parts of South-East Asia. The butterfly belongs to the mime subgenus, Chilasa, of the genus Papilio (black-bodied swallowtails). It is an excellent mimic of different species of Euploea (sub-family Danainae).

Parapoynx fluctuosalis is a moth of the Crambidae family. It is a widespread species, known from Africa, India, Sri Lanka, China, Japan, Malaysia, Taiwan, Guam, Hawaii, Fiji, Australia and the Galápagos Islands.

Parapoynx villidalis is a moth in the Crambidae family. It was described by Francis Walker in 1859. It is found in Australia (Queensland, New South Wales), Indonesia (Java, Borneo), China (Hong Kong), Taiwan, Malaysia and Thailand, as well as on Fiji.
Paratapes undulatus, common name undulate venus, is a species of saltwater clam, a marine bivalve mollusk in the family Veneridae, the Venus clams.
Paratectonatica tigrina, common name tiger moon snail, is a species of predatory sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Naticidae, the moon snails.
Paropeas achatinaceum is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Subulinidae.

Peregrinus maidis, known as the corn planthopper, is a species of insect in the order Hemiptera and the family Delphacidae. It is widespread throughout most tropical and subtropical regions on earth, including southern North America, South America, Africa, Australia, Southeast Asia and China. P.
Kamitetep (Phereoeca uterella) adalah spesies ngengat berwujud ulat berkepompong. Kepompongnya menyerupai biji labu, pipih, lunak, dan berwarna cokelat muda.
Phlaeoba infumata is a species of short-horned grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in Indomalaya.
Phyllium jacobsoni is a hybrid species of yellow/green leaf insect belonging to the family Phylliidae. Its recorded distribution is Java and no subspecies are listed in the Catalogue of Life.
Pinna muricata is a species of bivalves belonging to the family Pinnidae.
Planaxis sulcatus, common name the tropical periwinkle, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Planaxidae.

Polydesma boarmoides is a species of moth in the family Erebidae. The species is found from the Indo-Australian tropics east from Sri Lanka, to Australia, Fiji and New Caledonia. It has also been recorded from the Marianas, Carolines, Society Islands and Hawaii.

Portia albimana adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Portia dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1900 oleh Simon.
Propostira quadrangulata, is a species of spider of the genus Propostira. It is native to India and Sri Lanka.
Pseudomyagrus waterhousei is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae, and the only species in the genus Pseudomyagrus. It was described by Gahan in 1888.
Reticulidia suzanneae is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusk in the family Phyllidiidae.
Rhopobota naevana, the holly tortrix moth, holly leaf tier or blackheaded fireworm, is a moth of the Tortricidae family.
Rhynchodemus is a genus of land planarians in the tribe Rhynchodemini.
Sceliphron coromandelicum is a species of solitary mud dauber wasp in the family Sphecidae. The female holotype was collected in Coromandel Coast, India.

Scutigera coleoptrata, also known as the house centipede, is a species of centipede that is typically yellowish-gray and has up to 15 pairs of long legs. Originating in the Mediterranean region, it has spread to other parts of the world, where it frequently lives in and around human homes.
Diomus notescens, common name the minute two-spotted ladybird is a ladybird species endemic to the east and south of Australia.
Sphenarches zanclistes is a moth of the Pterophoridae family that is found in Australia.
Spilarctia vandepolli is a moth in the family Erebidae. It was described by Walter Rothschild in 1910. It is found in Sundaland. The habitat consists of lowland rain forests.
Stilbum cyanurum, the large cuckoo wasp, is a species of cuckoo wasps (insects in the family Chrysididae)....
Syritta orientalis is a species of syrphid fly in the family Syrphidae.

Tagiades parra is a species of spread-winged skipper butterflies in the genus Tagiades. It is found from Sikkim and Assam to Indochina and all throughout maritime Southeast Asia. The species was first described by the German entomologist Hans Fruhstorfer in 1910 as a subspecies of Tagiades gana.

Teleonemia scrupulosa, the lantana lace bug, is a species of lace bug in the family Tingidae. It is found in Africa, Australia, the Caribbean, Central America, North America, Oceania, South America, and Southern Asia.
Tetraponera allaborans, is a species of ant of the subfamily Myrmicinae, which can be found in many Asian countries.

The yellow crab spider, (Thomisus callidus), is a species of spider of the genus Thomisus. It is found in Sri Lanka, Singapore, Sumatra, Nias Island, and Java. They often hide in flowers and are able to change colors just to blend in to capture preys.

species.summary: Trochus radiatus, common name the radiate top shell, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Trochidae, the top snails.

Velarifictorus micado is a cricket in the subfamily Gryllinae ("field crickets"), in the family Gryllidae ("true crickets"). A common name for Velarifictorus micado is "Japanese burrowing cricket". The distribution range of Velarifictorus micado includes North America and Southern Asia.
Abisara echerius, the plum Judy, is a small but striking butterfly found in Asia belonging to the Punches and Judies family (Riodinidae). It is difficult to distinguish it from Abisara bifasciata.
Abisara kausambi, the straight plum Judy, is a small but striking butterfly found in the Indomalayan realm that belongs to the Punches and Judies, that is, the family Riodinidae.
Aceria hibisci, commonly known as the hibiscus erineum mite or hibiscus leaf-crumpling mite, is a species of eriophyid mite in the genus Aceria.
Acrocercops haplocosma is a moth of the family Gracillariidae, known from Java, Indonesia. It was described by Edward Meyrick in 1936. The hostplant for the species is Calophyllum inophyllum.

Ochlerotatus triseriatus, also known by the synonym Aedes triseriatus, is a member of the true fly order (Diptera: Culicidae). It is called the eastern tree hole mosquito due to its predilection towards breeding in stagnant water that is found in natural holding containers such as tree holes .
Aeromachus dubius, the dingy scrub-hopper, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. It ranges from India to China, including Malaya, Assam, Myanmar, Laos, Vietnam, Hainan and Yunnan.
Aetius nocturnus is a species of spider in the family Corinnidae (sac spiders). It was first described by Christa L. Deeleman-Reinhold in 2001.
Alcis variegata is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in India, Sikkim, Nepal, Myanmar, Laos, southern China, northern Vietnam, Thailand, Peninsular Malaysia and Sumatra.
Algia fasciata is a species of brush-footed butterfly found in Asia.
Allopeas gracile, common name the graceful awlsnail, is a species of small, tropical, air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Subulinidae.

Allotinus subviolaceus, the blue darkie, is a small butterfly found in South East Asia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family. The species was first described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1865.

Amplypterus mansoni is a species of moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from south-east Asia, including north-eastern India, Burma, Thailand, Laos, Vietnam, Malaysia and Indonesia (Sumatra and Java).
Angaria javanica is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Angariidae.
Araecerus fasciculatus, the Coffee Bean Weevil, is a species of beetles belonging to the family Anthribidae.

Archigenes savitri, the Malay tailed Judy, is a small butterfly found in Asia that belongs to the Punches and Judies, that is, the family Riodinidae. A 2015 study separated them from the genus Abisara to Archigenes.
Architectonica laevigata is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Architectonicidae, which are known as the staircase shells or sundials....

species.name: Kekep Babi
species.summary: Kekep babi (bahasa Latin: Artamus leucorynchus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Artamidae, dari genus Artamus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga kecil, kumbang, leba dan memiliki habitat di pesisir, sawah, kebun, tegalan, hutan sekunder. tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.500 m dpl.

Artema atlanta is a species of spider of the family Pholcidae with a pantropical distribution, introduced in Belgium and North America. It is commonly known as the giant daddy-long-legs spider. With a body length of 8–11 mm, it is the largest pholcid in the world.
Asota producta is a species of noctuoid moths in the Erebidae family. It is found from Sri Lanka and India to Sundaland.
Bassarona dunya, the great marquis, is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found in South-East Asia.
Bassarona teuta, the banded marquis, is a species of nymphalid butterfly.

Bavia capistrata adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Bavia dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1846 oleh C L Koch.
Bibasis etelka, the great orange awlet, is a species of skipper described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1871.

A sucker in zoology refers to a specialised attachment organ of an animal. It acts as an adhesion device in parasitic worms, several flatworms, cephalopods, certain fishes, amphibians, and bats. It is a muscular structure for suction on a host or substrate.
Bibasis harisa, the orange awlet, is a species of hesperid found in Asia. The butterfly was reassigned to genus Burara by Vane-Wright and de Jong (2003) and is considered by them to be Burara harisa.
Callidula sumatrensis is a moth of the family Callidulidae. It is found in Sundaland and Thailand. Its habitat consists of lowland forest.
Caltoris kumara, the blank swift, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Celaenorrhinus asmara, the white-banded flat, is a hesperiid butterfly which is found in South and Southeast Asia.

Celenna festivaria is a moth of the family Geometridae first described by Johan Christian Fabricius in 1794. It is found in India, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Borneo, Java Taiwan, the Ryukyu Islands and Luzon in the Philippines.
Cercidocerus securifer is a species of the family Curculionidae.
Charaxes borneensis is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Arthur Gardiner Butler in 1869. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.

Chirixalus pantaiselatan is a species of frog in the family Rhacophoridae. The species was discovered in 2021 by a group of students from the Bogor Agricultural Institute during a citizen science event. The species has only been found at the Leuweung Sancang Nature Reserve in Indonesia.
Chrysochroa buqueti, the red speckled jewel beetle, is a Southeast Asian species of beetle in the Buprestidae family.

Chrysomya bezziana, juga dikenal sebagai lalat ulat sekrup Dunia Lama (bahasa Inggris: New World screwworm fly), adalah spesies lalat yang bersifat parasit obligat pada mamalia sehingga ia membutuhkan inang untuk menyelesaikan tahapan perkembangannya. Nama spesies ini diambil dari ahli entomologi Italia, Mario Bezzi.
Cimex hemipterus is one of three species of bed bugs that feed on people. It is primarily a tropical insect.

Cirrhochrista annulifera is a moth in the family Crambidae. It is found in Papua New Guinea, on the D'Entrecasteaux Islands (Fergusson Island, Goodenough Island) and in Australia, where it has been recorded from Western Australia, the Northern Territory and Queensland.
Cirrochroa malaya is an Indomalayan species of heliconiine butterfly described by Cajetan and Rudolf Felder in 1860.

Coptotermes gestroi, the Asian subterranean termite is a small species of termite that lives underground. Both this species and the Formosan subterranean termite, (Coptotermes formosanus) are destructive pests native to Asia, but have spread to other parts of the world including the United States.
Culex sitiens is an insect native to coastal areas of East Africa and Madagascar, southwestern Asia, Ryukyu Archipelago, Korea, northern Australia and South Pacific islands.
The Double Tufted Royal Dacalana vidura is a species of blue butterfly found in South East Asia. It was described by Thomas Horsfield in 1857.
Delias descombesi, the redspot Jezebel is a medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites.
Deuterocopus planeta is a moth of the Pterophoridae family. It is found from India, through south-east Asia and the Indonesian Archipelago.

Diasemia accalis is a moth in the Crambidae family. It was described by Walker in 1859. It is found in Indonesia (Sumatra), China, the north-western Himalayas, Burma, Malaysia, Taiwan, Korea, Japan, the Democratic Republic of Congo and Rwanda.
Dophla evelina, the redspot duke, is a species of brush-footed butterfly found in South and Southeast Asia (Sri Lanka, Yunnan and India to the Philippines and Sulawesi). Many subspecies are accepted.

Glyphodes negatalis is a species of moth of the Crambidae family. It has a wide range in the tropics, including South Africa, Gambia, India, Hong Kong, Japan and eastern Australia (including New South Wales and Queensland).
Echinolittorina sundaica is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Littorinidae, the winkles or periwinkles.

Epepeotes lateralis adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong famili Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Epepeotes, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Eublemma cochylioides is a species of moth of the Erebidae family described by Achille Guenée in 1852.

Eudrilus eugeniae, also called the "African nightcrawler", is an earthworm species native to tropical west Africa and now widespread in warm regions under vermicompost; it is an excellent source of protein and has great pharmaceutical potential.

Eurema ada, the Talbot's Grass Yellow, is a species of butterfly in the genus Eurema. It was discovered in northern Borneo and described in 1871. Its main distinctive features are that its ground color is pale sulfurous, not white, and the border margins on its wings are blacker and wider. Wingspan is 35 mm.
Fasciola hepatica atau disebut juga Cacing hati merupakan anggota dari Trematoda (Platyhelminthes). Cacing hati mempunyai ukuran panjang 2,5 – 3 cm dan lebar 1 - 1,5 cm.

species.name: Tutut Jawa
species.summary: Tutut jawa (Filopaludina javanica) adalah sejenis siput air tawar anggota suku Viviparidae. Siput atau keong yang biasa ditemukan di sawah atau sungai ini acap dikonsumsi sebagai sumber protein yang murah dan mudah didapat, terutama di perdesaan di Jawa.

Gasteracantha fornicata adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1775 oleh Fabricius.
Gastropacha pardale, commonly called brown lapped moth, is a moth of the Lasiocampidae family.
Halgerda bacalusia is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, shell-less marine gastropod mollusks in the family Discodorididae.
Hasora khoda, the large banded awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in India, parts of Southeast Asia and Australia.

Helicoverpa assulta, the oriental tobacco budworm, is a moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found all over the Old World tropics, from South Africa through the Middle East, central and south-east Asia to Australia.
Heterometrus spinifer, the Giant Forest Scorpion or Giant Blue Scorpion, is a species of scorpions belonging to the family Scorpionidae.

Heteropsylla cubana (leucaena psyllid) is a species of in the family Psyllidae. It occurs in South and Central America as an insect plague (decline) on species of broadleaved trees, such as Albizia, Mimosa, Leucaena leucocephala and Samanea saman.
Heterorhina elegans is a species of scarab beetle found in India and Sri Lanka that belongs to the flower chafer subfamily.

Hipoepa fractalis is a species of moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found in Taiwan, China, Japan, Kenya, Korea, India, Malaysia, Nigeria, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Cape Verde, Réunion, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Sri Lanka, Uganda, Yemen and Australia (including Queensland).
Kaniska canace, the blue admiral, is a nymphalid butterfly, the only species of the genus Kaniska.

Leptaulax bicolor is a beetle of the Family Passalidae found throughout Australia, Cambodia, Eastern Himalayas, India, Indonesia: Borneo, Java, Moluccas, Sulawesi, Sumatra; Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, New Guinea, Philippines, Sri Lanka, Thailand and Vietnam.

Loboschiza koenigiana, the orange tortricid moth or leaf webber, is a species of moth of the Tortricidae family. It is found in the United Arab Emirates, Pakistan, India, Sri Lanka, Burma, China, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia (Java), New Guinea, Australia (Queensland), the Philippines, Taiwan, Japan and Korea.
Magilus antiquus, common name the Magilus coral snail, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Muricidae, the murex snails or rock snails.
Mansonia (Mansonioides) uniformis is a species of zoophilic mosquito belonging to the genus Mansonia.
Marumba tigrina is a species of moth of the family Sphingidae first described by Bruno Gehlen in 1936. It is known from Sumatra, Java and Borneo.
Maua albigutta is a cicada species that is widely distributed in Sumatra and Peninsular Malaysia and has been recorded once from Borneo

Moduza procris, the commander, sometimes included in the genus Limenitis, is a medium-sized, strikingly coloured brush-footed butterfly found in South Asia and Southeast Asia. It is notable for the mode of concealment employed by its caterpillar and the cryptic camouflage of its pupa.

Monopis monachella is a moth of the Tineidae family. It is widespread in Eurasia, Africa, India, Sri Lanka, Burma, Sumatra, Java, the Philippines, Taiwan, Japan, New Guinea, Samoa, North America and South America.
Natica vittellus is a species of predatory sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Naticidae, the moon snails.
Neptis nata, the clear sailer or dirty sailer, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South Asia.
Nosophora semitritalis is a moth in the Crambidae family. It was described by Lederer in 1863. It is found in China, Thailand, Taiwan and Japan.
Nothomastix pronaxalis is a moth in the family Crambidae. It was described by Francis Walker in 1859. It is found on Borneo.

Nyctemera lacticinia, the common nyctemera, is a species of moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in Japan, from the Oriental tropics of India, Sri Lanka, Myanmar to Taiwan, Peninsular Malaysia and Borneo.
Odonestis vita is a moth of the family Lasiocampidae first described by Moore in 1859. Three former subspecies are now recognized as separate species.

Omphisa anastomosalis, the sweetpotato vineborer, is a moth of the Crambidae family. It is widespread, with records including the Philippines, Indonesia, New Guinea, India, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Taiwan, Hawaii, Vietnam, China, Japan, Cambodia, Laos, Burma and Thailand.
Orphnaeus brevilabiatus is a species of centipedes in the family Oryidae. It is a littoral myriapod can be found throughout sublittoral zones of Indian and East Pacific countries.
Pandercetes plumipes, is a species of spider of the genus Pandercetes. It is native to Ambon Islands, Sri Lanka and New Guinea.
Parantica melaneus, the chocolate tiger, is a butterfly found in Asia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.

Pericyma cruegeri, the poinciana looper, is a moth of the family Noctuidae. It is found in south-east Asia including Hong Kong, Taiwan, Vietnam, Thailand, Sumatra, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, the Philippines, New Guinea, northern New South Wales and Queensland.
Phestilla sibogae is a species of sea slug, an aeolid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Trinchesiidae.
Phyllidiopsis gemmata is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusk in the family Phyllidiidae.

Polyrhachis rastellata is a species of ant in the subfamily Formicinae, found in few Asian countries. Two subspecies are recognized. Some texts include many more subspecies ranks. but it is debatable about these ranks. The following two subspecies are according to AntWiki.org

Potanthus serina, the large dart, is a species of butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found on the Andamans, as well as in southern Burma, Singapore and the Philippines. The habitat consists of grassy areas and mangrove areas.
Pseudocoladenia dan, the fulvous pied flat, is an Indomalayan butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Purpura bufo is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Muricidae, the murex snails or rock snails.
Purpura panama, common names Rudolph's purpura, salmon-lipped whelk, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk, in the family Muricidae, the murex snails or rock snails.

Caplak sapi (Boophilus microplus atau Rhipicephalus microplus) adalah sejenis serangga yang menyerang sapi.Kerugian yang ditimbulkan umumnya karena menghisap darah menyebabkan anemia, merusak kulit, dermatitis.Namun perananya yang lebih penting adalah sebagai vektor penyakit piroplasmosis, anaplasmosis dan theileriosis…

Rhysida immarginata is a species of centipedes in the family Scolopendridae. The species has been found in Africa (Sudan and Democratic Republic of the Congo), in South America (Cuba, El Salvador and Guatemala) and in Sri Lanka.

Rhyzopertha is a monotypic genus of beetles in the family Bostrichidae, the false powderpost beetles. The sole species, Rhyzopertha dominica, is known commonly as the lesser grain borer, American wheat weevil, Australian wheat weevil, and stored grain borer.
Roboastra tentaculata is a species of sea slug, a polycerid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Polyceridae.

Runcinia bifrons is a species of spiders of the genus Runcinia. It is native to India, Sri Lanka and Vietnam.
The Indian threadfish (Alectis indica), also known as the Indian threadfin, diamond trevally, mirror fish or plumed trevally, is a large species of coastal marine fish of the jack family, Carangidae.

Sia ferox (also known as Riokku (リオック, loanword orthography of Indonesian native name to Kana) or Obakekorogisu (オバケコロギス, "Obake raspy cricket") in Japan) is a species of crickets that lives in Indonesia, family Stenopelmatidae, genus Sia.
Smaragdinella calyculata, also called calyx bubble shell, is a small shelled slug common on rocky shores in the Indo-Pacific including Hawaii.
Taurometopa pyrometalla is a moth in the family Crambidae. It was described by Meyrick in 1933. It is found in Thailand.
Tetragnatha ceylonica is a species of spider in the family Tetragnathidae. It occurs widely across Asia and parts of Africa, and is commonly known as Ceylonica long-jawed spider.

Tetranychus urticae (common names include red spider mite and two-spotted spider mite) is a species of plant-feeding mite generally considered to be a pest. It is the most widely known member of the family Tetranychidae or spider mites.
Teulisna tumida is a species of moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in Borneo, Sumatra, China, India, Sri Lanka, Thailand and Taiwan.
Thinopteryx crocoptera is a moth of the family Geometridae first described by Vincenz Kollar in 1844. It is found in eastern Asia, including Japan, Thailand and Malaysia.
Thyrassia penangae is a species of moth in the family Zygaenidae. It is found in south-east Asia, including Peninsular Malaysia and China.

Toxorhynchites (Toxorhynchites) splendens is a species of non-hematophagous (not blood-feeding) mosquito belonging to the genus Toxorhynchites. It is widely used as a predator to control dengue mosquitoes.
Trochus maculatus, common name the maculated top shell, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Trochidae, the top snails.

The yellowspotted trevally (Carangoides fulvoguttatus), also known as the yellowspotted kingfish, goldspotted trevally, turrum, or yellowspot, is a widespread species of large inshore marine fish in the jack family Carangidae.
The bludger (Carangoides gymnostethus), also known as the bludger trevally, nakedbreast trevally or Bleeker's jackfish, is a widespread species of large marine fish in the jack family, Carangidae.
The warty venus, Venus verrucosa, is a species of saltwater clam. It is a species of marine bivalve mollusc in the family Veneridae, sometimes collectively known as the venus clams.
Vespa luctuosa is a species of hornet which is endemic to the Philippines. The main subspecies is Vespa luctuosa luctuosa (primarily native to Luzon island).

Xenocatantops humilis is the type species of grasshoppers in its genus of the family Acrididae and subfamily Catantopinae. This species can be found in India, Indo-China, Malesia (the type locality is Java), and Papua New Guinea.
Ypthima huebneri, the common fourring, is a species of Satyrinae butterfly found in Asia.
Zographetus ogygia, the purple spotted flitter, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
